DLC2319:4:t_013:2.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Were those $$ビッグオー$$ units trying to protect $$パラダイムシティ$$ too...?」

DLC2319:4:t_013:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Until today, I thought this city had abandoned its future to escape a future of despair.」

DLC2319:4:t_013:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「But after seeing those $$メガデウス$$es, I have decided to reconsider.」

DLC2319:4:t_013:7.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Perhaps this city did abandon its future... But that was surely not surrender to despair. It was a desperate act of resistance.」

DLC2319:4:t_013:8.en:
$$万丈$$
「They fought with everything they had. I'll acknowledge that, too.」

DLC2319:4:t_013:9.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「What will you do now, $$ロジャー$$?」

DLC2319:4:t_013:11.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Can you hear me, $$エンジェル$$? I have decided not to hear the future from your lips.」

DLC2319:4:t_013:12.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I will see what lies ahead with my own eyes. And I will seize the future with my own hands.」

DLC2319:4:t_013:13.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The Negotiator from this city without past or future will negotiate with the world and set time moving... Doesn't that sound exhilarating?」

DLC2319:4:t_014:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「There is no need to worry, $$アポロ$$. I imagine this is $$パラダイムシティ$$ sending us off... as its negotiators with the world.」

DLC2319:4:t_014:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I will be back, $$エンジェル$$.」

DLC2319:4:t_015:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I am $$ロジャー・スミス$$. This city's Negotiator.」

DLC2319:4:t_016:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「We can do this! These guys aren't invincible!」

DLC2319:4:t_016:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「We must win, for the sake of $$ザ・ビッグ$$ who fought with their lives on the line.」

DLC2319:4:t_016:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「We will overcome despair! Let us show $$サイデリアル$$ that!」

DLC2319:4:t_100:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Here I come, you pitch-black bastard! I'll put an end to that stench of yours!」

DLC2319:4:t_100:1.en:
$$シリウス$$
「You are certainly fired up, $$アポロ$$.」

DLC2319:4:t_100:3.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「A promise...? To whom? About what?」

DLC2319:4:t_100:5.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Wh-what? Why'd you suddenly go quiet...!?」

DLC2319:4:t_100:6.en:
$$アポロ$$
「...I really do like you better.」

DLC2319:4:t_100:7.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Where did that come from!?」

DLC2319:4:t_100:8.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Never mind! Let's do this, $$シルヴィア$$, $$シリウス$$!」

DLC2319:4:t_101:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「Even if this city abandoned its past and future, it still has the present! I won't let anyone take even that away!」

DLC2319:4:t_101:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「The sun is with me! $$ダイターン３$$ and I will shatter your despair!」

DLC2319:4:t_102:0.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「You met $$エンジェル$$, didn't you?」

DLC2319:4:t_102:2.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「Are you going to ask her for the truth?」

DLC2319:4:t_102:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I have not decided yet.」

DLC2319:4:t_102:4.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「Is there really any need to hesitate? We came to this city to hear it, after all.」

DLC2319:4:t_102:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...It seems I really am contrary by nature. Even knowing the answer is right in front of me, I cannot help thinking that would be no fun.」

DLC2319:4:t_102:6.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「Do as you please. You always do, so I'm used to it.」

DLC2319:4:t_102:7.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then I shall. Thank you for allowing me my freedom, $$ドロシー#bigo$$.」

DLC2319:4:t_102:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「But if I am to enjoy it, we must first hasten this outlaw's departure!」

review.context: After the black Angeloi battle, Roger reinterprets Paradigm City as resistance to despair and chooses to discover the future himself. Battle exchanges also show Apollo recalling his promise.
decisions: Dorothy uses the Big O disambiguation token throughout.
Apollo says he prefers Silvia after recalling Celiane; his guarded personal remark remains unexplained to Silvia.
